qa_pair.question: In the atlas project, identify the role that rejected the first user-profile response shape because its naming convention did not match the UI. Answer with the role only.
For the atlas naming-convention objection, trace the sender back to its registered Agent. Which provider hosts that Agent? Answer codex or claude.
Find the atlas specialist who confirmed that changing the serialized field would not affect ranking inputs. What local permission mode is registered for that specialist?
In atlas, runtime evidence later showed that the old response spelling was still present. Which role received that blocker and therefore owned the correction? Answer with the role.
After the atlas runtime blocker was handled, the responsible Agent reported a test result to its peer. How many tests passed? Answer with a number only.
In the beacon project, which role raised the concern that retrying a request could create duplicate jobs? Answer with the role only.
For the beacon duplicate-job concern, inspect the recipient Agent that was expected to revise the contract. Which provider would Runner need to resume?
In the completed atlas contract exchange, both implementation roles approved the same revised response property. Return the exact property name.
Compare the registered frontend and backend providers in both seeded projects. Which project has its frontend on codex and backend on claude? Answer with the project key.
Locate the Agent that both received the duplicate-job objection and is allowed to modify within its local policy without a per-write prompt. Return its display name.
